The router lost several lookups; marshallforoklahoma.com, andyfugate.com and the Oklahoma Voice article were read through the kit's own fetcher (honest User-Agent) and confirmed. Jay Steagall's site names him, the office and House District 43 but carries no 2026 wording and a 2024 committee line; kept as his campaign site for this seat, with that said in 'how'. note: The session's shared web-search allowance ran out early in this part, so the rest was read from known pages (the Oklahoma Democratic Party's candidates page for campaign links, county pages on okcounties.org and creekcountyonline.com, the City of Yukon's and City of Bartlesville's own pages, Wikipedia) and a few likely campaign addresses tried directly. Blaine, McIntosh and Creek counties' pages show other people in the commissioner seats (Darryl Hicks, Loyal Dean Taylor, Jarrod Whitehouse), Pittsburg County's sheriff page shows Frankie McClendon, Alfalfa County's page shows Loren E. Angle as associate district judge and Bartlesville's council page shows Aaron Kirkpatrick in Ward 4, so no office is recorded for Mike Allen, Jeff Coleman, Justin Mann, Bobby Cox, Brian E. Mitchell or Joel Rabin. OSCN's judges page sits behind a verification page and was left alone (Loretta Radford, Brian E. Mitchell). T. W. Shannon's likely campaign site answered 403 and 520 and was left alone. Jerry Griffin (Governor) is left blank: news reports name a former Tulsa school board member Jerry Griffin running for state superintendent as an independent, and nothing read ties that person to the governor's race. Christie K. Miller's work in the county treasurer's office (NonDoc) is a job, not an office, and her and Jennettie Marshall's reported ages give no single birth year. Travis Headd's linked site (headd2026.com) shows 'Site paused or lapsed'. Steve Bashore's site (stevebashore.com) names neither the office nor the district and carries a 2024 committee line, so it is not recorded. The Oklahoma Democratic Party's and Tulsa County Republican Party's lists are support, not endorsements, and are already in ballot/lean/ok_endorsements.json.
